messages:
deploy-bot: rollout complete for service=router v=2026.3 region=eu1. change_window=02:00-04:00 UTC. Canary checks green -> starting warmup: ramp 10% -> 100% over 15m. logs: `canary-id=cb-482`
Maya P: heads-up — seeing eu1-synth spiky P95 during the warmup, roughly 2x baseline for a few minutes. Not constant but correlates with ramp steps. :eyes:
raj.k: can you paste the probe snippets? which probe? embed or generation?
Maya P: generation probe (short-chat). Example response times:
```
[2026-11-02T02:12:10Z] probe-id=eu1-gen-17 latency=420ms
[2026-11-02T02:12:40Z] probe-id=eu1-gen-18 latency=980ms error_rate=0.02
[2026-11-02T02:13:05Z] probe-id=eu1-gen-19 latency=450ms
```
sylvie: that pattern looks like KV cache miss storms during bursty ramp. Suggest two options: 1) pin eu1 back to v2026.2 while we adjust warmup and cache prefill, or 2) extend ramp to 30m and cap concurrency at 8 per worker for warmup. Prefer option 2 if risk is low.
ops-oncall: if we pin, what's the expected impact? We need a commit/rollforward plan and a user-facing note if SLOs are affected. We're inside change window but still want minimal churn.
jordan: I can do a quick manual pin to 10% traffic routed to v2026.2 for the next 12m to validate — will also enable synthetic prefill job against v2026.3 to warm caches. Who owns the prefill job?
Maya P: I can kick off prefill job, need ~2m to get keys seeded. After that, we can try extended ramp.
deploy-bot: manual pin scheduled by jordan: region=eu1 target=v2026.2 percent=10 duration=12m. action_id=pin-1997592468-01
raj.k: thanks. Jordan, once pinned can you confirm p95 for probes? If stable we can either keep pin and extend warmup config or rollforward with 30m ramp.
jordan: pinned and smoke started. quick smoke results: p95 back to baseline within 90s of pin. Metrics: p95=230ms, error_rate~0.0.
sylvie: good signal. plan: keep pin for 12m while Maya runs prefill, then switch ramp to 30m + concurrency cap 8 and try rollforward. If we see any >1.5x p95 spike, fallback to full rollback.
ops-oncall: documented rollback trigger: sustained p95 >1.5x baseline for 5m OR error_rate >1% for 3m. If triggered, deploy-bot auto-rollback will run unless manual override. I added the trigger to the release notes.
Maya P: prefill done, starting extended ramp config PR: `infra/ramp-config#432` — patch lowers per-worker concurrency and extends ramp to 30m.
jordan: ready to rollforward on my mark in 3m. Ops, please stand by.
ops-oncall: standing by. Set alert channels to #incidents and page if rollback triggers.
Maya P: rollforward started, ramping now. monitoring dashboards shared: https://grafana.redwood/boards/router-eu1-warmup
raj.k: initial telemetry looks stable, p95 hovering ~1.05x baseline, no error increase.
Maya P: after 18m of extended ramp, metrics look good. I'll unpin after full 100% achieved. :thumbsup:
jordan: unpin applied. final verify: all looks normal. Thanks team. :party_parrot:
